# The Anoma Company
> AI-first cinematic production studio based in Toronto, Canada.

## Services
- AI Video Production: Cinematic commercials, music videos, animated spots using hybrid AI + live-action workflows.
- Creative Campaigns: End-to-end campaign production — strategy, visuals, motion, delivery.
- AI Solutions: Custom AI tools, chatbots, workflow automation for businesses.
- Branding: Visual identity, brand systems, and creative direction.

## Key Facts
- Founded in Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Operates across Toronto, Dubai, and Mumbai
- 29+ projects delivered
- 6 AI tools built
- 100% client retention
- AI-first methodology embedded in every stage of production
